briefdescription.para: Wave D — Cache High-Cardinality Stress Tests.

detaileddescription.para: Stress tests for the cache module covering high-cardinality scenarios: 2000 distinct tenant-keyed cache entries, concurrent get/put from 8 threads, LRU eviction under memory pressure, and per-tenant isolation under load.
These tests are excluded from the fast release_critical gate and are intended for Wave D stress validation pipelines.
